item.title: Three injured following overnight shooting on Florida Boulevard
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Three people were injured in an overnight shooting on Florida Boulevard on Sunday.According to officials, the shooting occurred around 3:40 a.m., leaving two people on the scene injured.&nbsp;The two victims were transported to a local hospital, with one in serious condition.&nbsp;Officials said a third victim departed for the hospital prior to their arrival.Permalink| Comments

item.title: One injured in stabbing on Iberville Street, officials say
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Authorities are investigating a Sunday night stabbing on Iberville Street.The stabbing occurred around 5:50 p.m., leaving one person injured. The victim was transported to a local hospital.Officials are currently on the scene.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: LSU's Tiger Girls dance team secures two second-place finishes at national championship
item.description: ORLANDO &mdash;&nbsp;LSU's dance team is returning home with two awards following the 2026 UDA College and Dance Team National Championships on Sunday.&nbsp;The Tiger Girls secured two second-place finishes at the competition, placing in both the Hip Hop and Jazz categories.&nbsp;The second-place finish in Jazz is the highest Jazz placement in the program's history.&nbsp;View this post on InstagramA post shared by LSU (@lsu)Permalink| Comments

item.title: West Baton Rouge Museum hosts Cajun Jam
item.description: PORT ALLEN - The West Baton Rouge Museum hosted its monthly Cajun Jam with the Cajun French Music Association on Sunday afternoon.&nbsp;Attending musicians played instruments from fiddles and accordions to the washboard.&nbsp;The CFMA says it is a dedicated event honoring the preservation of Cajun music and culture.&nbsp;If you missed this month's event, plan to attend the next one. The free event happens on the third Sunday of every month from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m.Permalink| Comments

item.title: 'It was just outrageous:' Drivers on Atchafalaya Basin Bridge trapped for hours after 18-wheeler fire
item.description: BUTTE LA ROSE - Dozens of drivers endured a tense and frightening ordeal this weekend on I-10 West after an 18-wheeler overturned and caught fire on the Atchafalaya Basin Bridge.The crash happened Friday night near Whiskey Bay, in the middle of the 18-mile-long bridge. item.title: Louisiana State Police looking for missing 13-year-old, last seen around New Orleans
item.description: NEW ORLEANS &mdash; Louisiana State Police has issued a level 2 missing child advisory for 13-year-old Helen Galvez.Officials say she went missing from her home on Old Gentilly Road in New Orleans, around 6:50 Sunday morning.&nbsp;Galvez is a Hispanic female with brown eyes and black curly hair. She is 5 feet and weighs around 120 pounds.&nbsp;Anyone with information is asked to call the New Orleans Police Department at (504) 658-6070.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments
